message.content:
Here is a brief vetting summary of **Sejahtera Kirana Engineering Sdn. Bhd.** to help your team decide whether to pursue them as a supplier or project partner. ### **Executive Summary: Sejahtera Kirana Engineering Sdn. Bhd.** | Category | Overview | | :--- | :--- | | **Company Profile** | • **Industry:** Construction (Civil engineering works for roads and drainage)
• **Location:** Terengganu, Malaysia
• **Established:** April 2001 (Active, Private Limited)
• **Ownership:** Majority-owned by Mega Holdings Sdn. Bhd. (60%) and Managing Director (40%) | | **Audit & Compliance** | • **Litigation:** Clean record (no recorded legal cases).
• **Audit Opinions:** Consistently received **Unqualified (clean) audits** from Audit Firm 7 across all evaluated years (2022–2024). | --- ### **Financial Performance (2022 – 2024)** * **Steady Top-Line Growth:** Revenue grew consistently from **MYR 7.43M** in 2022 to **MYR 8.20M** in 2024. * **Improving Profitability:** Net profit after tax (PAT) nearly doubled over the three-year period, rising from **MYR 123.3k** (2022) to **MYR 217.0k** (2024). Net profit margins remain modest but positive (~2.65% in 2024). * **Liquidity Improvement:** The quick ratio improved year-over-year, moving from 0.96 in 2022 to a healthier **1.14 in 2024**, indicating sufficient short-term assets to cover immediate liabilities. * **Cash Flow Turning Point:** Operating cash flow improved significantly, jumping from MYR 90.9k in 2022 to **MYR 528.4k** in 2024, successfully pushing Free Cash Flow into positive territory (**MYR 187.9k**) by 2024. --- ### **Key Risk Considerations** * **Leverage & Debt:** The company carries significant borrowings (MYR 4.66M in 2024 against total equity of MYR 4.26M, resulting in a leverage ratio of ~1.64). * **Interest Coverage:** While improving (1.70x in 2022 to 2.12x in 2024), debt-servicing capability remains relatively tight and warrants monitoring. * **Working Capital Cycle:** Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) is on the higher side (113 days in 2024), meaning receivables take a while to collect, which slightly stretches their cash conversion cycle (102 days). ### **Recommendation** **Worth a closer look.** Sejahtera Kirana Engineering is a stable, long-standing civil engineering contractor with clean audits, growing revenues, and improving cash flows. However, due diligence teams should review their debt commitments and collection cycles (DSO) during contract negotiations.
